payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing the source and edited images, has the woman’s jacket moved toward being closed, and is it now fully closed?
node.criteria: Assess change from source to edited image. complete: the jacket is fully closed in the edited image. partial: it is more closed than in the source but is not fully closed. absent: there is no visible progress toward closing it, or it is equally or more open. unknown: insufficient visual evidence to compare the jacket’s closure between images.
node.binding: Visual target: the woman’s jacket. Reference: “Make her close her jacket fully.”

outcome.description: The woman’s jacket is closed fully.
outcome.reference: Make her close her jacket fully
